name: loomi-playbooks
description: Playbooks that chain Loomi Connect skills into one job, from finding a problem to fixing, testing and measuring it, with a hand-off file that carries results between stages and sessions: test and learn, fix one search, findability, facets, ranking algorithms, search demand to revenue, lifecycle gaps, second purchase, on-site tests, catalog truth, revenue drops, peak events, governance, weekly triage, quarter close and more.
